text: inside of the painting tools [Image #83] (the one in my image) can u give a text tool for typing
resolution: Added a TEXT tool to the model paint panel (the painter in the user's image). Selecting it (or pressing T) reveals a TEXT input; typing a string and clicking a face lays the text out as 5x7 bitmap glyphs and stamps one filled square dab per lit cell into the paint texture, scissor-clamped to the hit face's UV island so it can't bleed onto a neighbour. Brush SIZE sets the glyph scale and brush COLOUR the ink; the block centres on the click. Implemented as a one-click model-texture op handled Studio-side (like faceFill), not through the kit stroke engine, since text is a stamp not a stroke. The bitmap font + layoutText() live in the universal paint kit (runtime/paint/glyphs.ts) and 'text' is now a first-class BrushTool (icon=T glyph, hotkey t, label), so any BrushKit-based cart can offer it; Studio surfaces it via an explicit tools list. Verified: full hmsc-int cart bundles clean via the real esbuild flags, and the paint kit test suite passes 21/21 including 5 new glyph-layout tests. Live in-app paint needs rjit dev (headless shot can't capture Paintable content).
